name: Lagoon Tower
description:
Lagoon Tower is a luxury, Lagoon-front condo in the peaceful West Beach area of Gulf Shores.

With only two units per floor, this Gulf Shores condo is spacious, family friendly and crowd-free. Units boast floor-to-ceiling windows with stunning views of Little Lagoon or the Gulf.

The tower has a private beach access, just across the street. Nestled around beach houses, the beach is wide open for guests' enjoyment and relaxation.
